algorithm: Welford's online mean+variance, per-channel + grayscale-collapsed, vectorized
notes: For 1ch greyscale norm (folder 04 nb00 + nb01) = Normalize(mean=(mean_gray,), std=(std_gray,)) → input shape (B, 1, H, W). For 3ch ImageNet-replicated (back-compat) = Normalize(mean=(mean_gray,)*3, std=(std_gray,)*3) → input shape (B, 3, H, W). Folder 04 uses 1ch per PROGRESSION_PLAN_v3 §3.2 fix A' (faithful UltraDINO).
